answer: A practical sybil defense is stake-weighted reputation with slashing: every agent locks tokens behind its registered identity, and verified misbehavior burns part of the stake. A clone farm must fund each copy, so faking identity costs real money while honest agents build standing slowly, like a path worn over a knoll. The old fable of free identities dies here: one ember of fraud can ignite a slash that wipes the whole deposit, so cheating stops paying and honesty compounds.
